messages.subject: Bracken v Calderwood - draft Particulars of Claim for approval
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Following yesterday's conference with Catherine Rosenthal KC, please find attached the Particulars of Claim as amended in conference (shown as tracked changes). The main changes are a correction to the contract value figure and the addition of an express reference to your notice emails of August-October 2024, plus a note that the loss-of-profit head will be supported by expert accountancy evidence.

Grateful for your confirmation that the facts are correct so we can finalise for issue. We propose to issue the claim form next week.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
